requirements.statement: Make one canonical ChangeGraph authoritative for planning, with WorkUnit-local intent and typed Edge records as the only dependency authority.

Deterministically validate graph/node/edge identities, endpoints, duplicate and self hard dependencies, hard cycles, resource identities, requirements, evidence requirements, provenance, and canonical serialization without rejecting resource conflicts.

Read supported mission v1/v2 only through explicit deterministic adapters into ChangeGraph while preserving uncertainty and never inventing grants, runtime observations, scheduler decisions, lifecycle state, or personas.

Expose stable mission/change-graph validation, normalization, serialization, and read-only frontier interfaces; keep only required migration aliases and remove dispatch/scheduler/persona projections from mission-facing routes.
